item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a clean public example in this pass of Tinubu personally retracting a proven false claim and apologizing for it. I also did not find strong direct evidence on court-facing or ally-facing truthfulness in 2024; the usable record here is mostly speeches, fact-checks, and media-freedom / crackdown reporting. The correction evidence is mostly reactive and partial, not a pattern of proactive self-correction.","evidence":[{"title":"FULL TEXT: Tinubu speaks on economic reforms, new minimum wage in Democracy Day speech","publisher":"TheCable","date":"2024-06-12","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/full-text-tinubu-speaks-on-economic-reforms-new-minimum-wage-in-democracy-day-speech/","summary":"Tinubu publicly acknowledged that reforms had created hardship and said his government negotiated with labour rather than relying on arrests or repression. This is the strongest direct 2024 evidence for admitting difficulty rather than denying it.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Broadcast on the Nationwide Protest","publisher":"State House","date":"2024-08-04","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"He acknowledged deaths, destruction, unrest, and legitimate public frustration, and asked for dialogue. This is partial openness to truthful crisis reporting, though it stopped short of accepting responsibility for the crackdown.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"Tinubu orders probe of security agents involved in arrest, detention of minors","publisher":"TheCable","date":"2024-11-04","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/tinubu-orders-probe-of-security-agents-involved-in-arrest-detention-of-minors/","summary":"After backlash over detained minors, Tinubu ordered an investigation and said officers could face discipline. This is the clearest late corrective action I found in the 2024 record.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"Verifying claims by Bola Tinubu’s media team amid #EndBadGoverance protests in Nigeria","publisher":"Africa Check","date":"2024-08-08","url":"https://africacheck.org/fact-checks/reports/verifying-claims-bola-tinubus-media-team-amid-endbadgoverance-protests-nigeria","summary":"Africa Check found the presidency’s economic infographic mixed: some claims were correct, but reserves were understated and the ways-and-means debt claim was incorrect or unproven. This supports the view that official messaging often overstated the reform story.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"Fact-checking Tinubu's independence day speech","publisher":"FactCheckHub","date":"2024-10-03","url":"https://factcheckhub.com/fact-checking-tinubus-independence-day-speech/","summary":"FactCheckHub found Tinubu’s claim that Nigeria attracted more than $30 billion in FDI was false, and that his reserve claim was mostly false, even though some other claims were true. This is strong evidence against consistent honesty in public messaging.","question_ids":["7B.2","7B.1"]},{"title":"Nigeria has detained journalist who reported on corruption in widening crackdown","publisher":"Reuters via GPB","date":"2024-05-09","url":"https://www.gpb.org/news/2024/05/09/nigeria-has-detained-journalist-who-reported-on-corruption-in-widening-crackdown","summary":"Police detained Daniel Ojukwu under the Cybercrime Act after corruption reporting. This is direct negative evidence that truth-tellers could be punished.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"Nigeria police charge 4 journalists with cybercrimes for corruption reporting","publisher":"Committee to Protect Journalists","date":"2024-10-03","url":"https://cpj.org/2024/10/nigeria-police-charge-4-journalists-with-cybercrimes-for-corruption-reporting/","summary":"CPJ reported that four journalists were charged under the Cybercrimes Act despite February reforms. This shows the administration still tolerated legal pressure on critical reporting late in 2024.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"Nigeria","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/nigeria/freedom-net/2024","summary":"Freedom House reported no internet shutdowns during the coverage period, which is weak positive evidence for allowing reporting. But it also documented cyberstalking-law abuse, monitoring of “false information,” and blocking powers, so openness remained constrained.","question_ids":["7B.2"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges protesters with treason inciting military","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-09-02","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/","summary":"Prosecutors framed protest leaders as destabilizers and mutineers. This is negative evidence for the “admit and correct” side because the state doubled down with punitive legal framing instead of treating criticism as legitimate.","question_ids":["7B.2"]}]}
